title: A Napkin of New Recipes
story: At the cultural evening, each family brought one dish and a short story about it. Noor carried a lentil stew that her aunt had taught her to season slowly. She had written the story on a card, but the room was noisy and she put the card in her pocket. People tried the stew and asked what gave it the warm smell. Noor forgot the formal story and simply named the spices and the aunt who never measured them. An older guest said that kind of memory was better than a speech. Noor left with an empty pot and three new recipes written on a napkin.

quiz.question: What was each family asked to bring?
options: One dish and a short story about it
Only a written card, with no food
Three recipes on a napkin
A speech and nothing to eat
quiz.correctAnswer: One dish and a short story about it
quiz.explanation: At the cultural evening, each family brought one dish and a short story about it.
quiz.supportingSentence: At the cultural evening, each family brought one dish and a short story about it.

quiz.question: Why did Noor's written story stay in her pocket?
options: The card described someone else's dish
A noisy room was a poor place for a formal reading
Her aunt had told her not to speak
She had forgotten to bring the stew
quiz.correctAnswer: A noisy room was a poor place for a formal reading
quiz.explanation: The room was noisy, and she put the written card away before speaking in a simpler way.
quiz.supportingSentence: She had written the story on a card, but the room was noisy and she put the card in her pocket.

quiz.question: What did Noor say when people asked about the smell?
options: She read the whole card aloud
She refused to name any ingredient
She named the spices and the aunt who never measured them
She said the stew came from the older guest
quiz.correctAnswer: She named the spices and the aunt who never measured them
quiz.explanation: She forgot the formal story and named the spices and the aunt who never measured them.
quiz.supportingSentence: Noor forgot the formal story and simply named the spices and the aunt who never measured them.

quiz.question: What does the ending suggest about the evening?
options: Noor shared her stew and came away with recipes from other people
Nobody tasted the dish she had brought
She left before the event started
The napkin she carried home was blank
quiz.correctAnswer: Noor shared her stew and came away with recipes from other people
quiz.explanation: She leaves with an empty pot and three new recipes, so food and ideas were exchanged.
quiz.supportingSentence: Noor left with an empty pot and three new recipes written on a napkin.

quiz.question: What does season mean in this story?
options: To cook a dish only in one part of the year
To flavour food, as her aunt had taught her
To write a story on a small card
To measure every spice with a spoon
quiz.correctAnswer: To flavour food, as her aunt had taught her
quiz.explanation: Her aunt taught her to season the stew slowly, meaning to build its flavour.
quiz.supportingSentence: Noor carried a lentil stew that her aunt had taught her to season slowly.
